<xpln lang="en"> <etym lang="tbd">[Lat. <term lang="la">abbatia;</term> from whence probably
first ABBACY; which see.]</etym> A monastery of religious per­
sons, whether men or women; distinguished from religious
houses of other denominations by larger privileges. See
ABBOT.
<term lang="quo">With easy roads he came to Leicester;
Lodg'd in the abbey, where the reverend abbot,
With all his convent, honourably receiv'd him.
Shakesp. Henry VIII.</term></xpln>
